one public REST call, kept verbatim. This venue serves its maintenance margin ladder per symbol and needs no API key; asking without a symbol returns 407 rows covering 15 symbols and a cursor, so reading the whole venue that way is ~56 paged calls for ~840 symbols against the 50 this system captures. BTCUSDT is the fixture because its ladder is the longest and spans the widest range of notional, which is what exercises the floor-from-the-ceiling-below reading: this venue states riskLimitValue as a tier CEILING, and reading it as a floor would price every position under the first ceiling with the wrong rate.

one public fetch of Upstox's own NSE instrument master (76,596 rows, no token required), cut to the rows broker-symbol-universe-bridge selects from: the NIFTY and BANKNIFTY index instruments, the whole of NIFTY's nearest expiry (174 contracts, expiry 2026-09-08) so ranking by distance from the money runs against a real strike ladder, and 20 contracts of the following expiry so 'nearest expiry only' is a claim these rows can falsify. Kept verbatim -- field names, the millisecond expiry and the NSE_INDEX|Nifty 50 underlying_key are Upstox's own.

The 30 underlyings are DERIVED, not typed: NSE indices and shares that some option is written on, ranked by contract count off the real instrument master -- NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, RELIANCE, TCS, ICICIBANK and the rest. captures.why_it_matters: the 2-underlying capture has 13 gaps between stories and its nearest-rank 95th percentile EQUALS its maximum, so news-source-health-monitor's middle state was unreachable on it -- a Rule 8 defect found by a test failing. This one carries 31 stories in 42 rows over 167.08 hours and 30 gaps (median 1.8h, p95 17.9h, longest 28.4h), which separates all three delivery states. It also re-confirms the deduplicator's 0.8 threshold on a 3x wider real sample: 11 rows collapse by url, 0 by headline, and the closest pair it refuses to collapse still scores 0.600
